variants.text: Silver Volkswagen Polo hatchback with alloy wheels and fog lights.
Silver Volkswagen Polo hatchback featuring multi-spoke alloy wheels, front bumper fog lights, and a rearview mirror air freshener.
That is a silver Volkswagen Polo hatchback; you can spot it by the alloy wheels, the fog lights on the front bumper, and there is an air freshener hanging from the rearview mirror.
